stem:
A 28-year-old woman has had two episodes of monocular vision loss that resolved over weeks, and MRI now shows multifocal white-matter lesions. Nerve conduction studies of affected central pathways show slowed propagation.

Loss of which of the following properties of myelinated axons most directly accounts for the slowed conduction?

options.label: A
options.text: Continuous opening of channels along the entire axonal membrane
options.misconception: The unmyelinated pattern is being treated as what demyelination removes.
options.explanation: Continuous conduction is the slower unmyelinated strategy; demyelination removes the insulation that enables saltatory, node-to-node renewal.

options.label: B
options.text: Saltatory regeneration of the action potential at nodes of Ranvier
options.misconception: None; myelin loss impairs node-to-node saltatory conduction.
options.explanation: In myelinated axons the action potential regenerates only at nodes of Ranvier and jumps between them; demyelination disrupts that saltatory pattern and slows conduction.

options.label: C
options.text: Active glial pumping of depolarization down the fiber
options.misconception: Glia are being given an active propulsive role they do not have.
options.explanation: Oligodendrocytes insulate; they do not pump the signal. Slowing after demyelination reflects loss of saltatory node-to-node renewal.

options.label: D
options.text: Amplification of action-potential peak voltage at each segment
options.misconception: All-or-none spikes are being treated as size-adjustable amplifiers.
options.explanation: Action potentials are all-or-none at a fixed peak; nodes renew the same amplitude rather than amplifying it, and demyelination slows by breaking saltatory jump.

options.label: E
options.text: Widening of axonal diameter that lowers internal resistance
options.misconception: A size-based speed factor is being substituted for the myelin mechanism.
options.explanation: Diameter affects speed in any axon, but the demyelination-specific loss is saltatory conduction between nodes of Ranvier.

context: Learning objective: link demyelination to loss of saltatory conduction. Myelinated axons regenerate the action potential only at nodes of Ranvier; myelin loss slows propagation by disrupting that node-to-node jump.
